variants.reason: A takeable non-furniture scrap item with one declared tile. No invented S/E/N, stack piles, repair/burning variants or procedural animation.
variants.binding: Bind replacement to exact Scrap Electronics identity, not globally to bit11.bmp: Scrap Metal, Scrap Crystal and Scrap Energy reuse this same tile with other identities/colours.

palette.TileColor: Absent throughout resolved inheritance: native tile rendering uses ColorString &C.
palette.mask_contract: Retain independent primary/detail roles even though both native tints are currently equal. Neutral artwork plus weight and coverage; do not bake cyan, donor white/blue, green PCB or background.

semantics.native: A fractured microchip shed/peeled from a machine fossil; TinkerItem Bits=C and inherited disassembly remain native.
semantics.authored: Diamond-like perimeter with two opposing occupied triangular regions and open fracture pockets. Etched contact traces and shallow planar thickness are authored visual interpretation, not additional source parts.
semantics.prohibited: Do not replace with complete modern green PCB, generic circuit box, pile, SignalChip micro-organ or imported mechanoid/research behavior.
